# One-dimensional PDPs for house price prediction

This fragment contains the helper and calls for `bedrooms`, `bathrooms`, `sqft_living`, and `floors`. See the main notebook for full plotting code. 

```{r helper-house-pdp}
plot_house_pdp_1d <- function(pdp_data, feature, title, x_label) {
  ggplot(pdp_data, aes(x = .data[[feature]], y = yhat)) +
    geom_line(size = 1, color = "#2D4F73") +
    geom_rug(
      data = house_sample,
      aes(x = .data[[feature]]),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      sides = "b",
      alpha = 0.2,
      color = "#5A4635"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format(prefix = "$")) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = x_label,
      y = "Predicted house price"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```
